install_configuration.reason: The fixed v1 export requires absent or empty immutable application-wide global labels.

contract: Opt-in v1 Prometheus text-format pull observation of six fixed Elzoo job/effect events and five fixed adapter/operation/family pairs: event counts and terminal duration microsecond sums, at most 15 count plus 10 duration series, only finite adapter/operation/phase labels; fixed registry, explicit initialization and singleton attach/detach, no exporter process or queue. Exclusive serialized host registry ownership and immutable absent/empty global labels are Needs. Missing/invalid duration does not suppress valid event count; provider failures lose updates and count/duration are not transactional. Catchable handler failures are contained without raw log/failure-event disclosure.
limits: No server, network transport, audit/accounting, tracing, durable observation, retry, sampling or automatic provider recovery.
Synchronous CPU/ETS contention affects callers; no hard deadline isolation. Scrape is not an atomic snapshot and selected callbacks may finish after detach.
Public definition probes establish existence/arity only; initialization plus exclusive immutable host ownership establishes identity, not hostile same-VM isolation.
Fixed row cardinality does not bound whole-VM memory, numeric magnitude or formatted decimal length. Finite tests and named upstream contracts, not a universal proof.

grounding.claim: Finite public API and actual telemetry/text-output scenarios: closed 25-series projection and invalid cross-products; duration boundaries; ignored secret markers; lifecycle, config/collector/definition refusal, provider restart, failed duration update and concurrent exact quiescent totals.

Actual source exporter with in-memory registration before serialized metadata adoption; selected closure runs tests in a clean independent consumer with declared provider application paths and no root Application.
Public counters, exclusive registry operations and standard text formatter; fixed 16 counter stripes at the pinned source, not a whole-VM memory bound.
Synchronous callback dispatch, registration independent of attacher lifetime, and already-selected callbacks can outlive detach.
Host serializes administrative lifecycle calls, exclusively reserves the fixed registry and keeps absent/empty global labels immutable; no concurrent external mutation or hostile same-VM isolation.

telemetry.contract: Two fixed optional observation counters, no durable or accounting claim.

config.contract: Fixed schema/registry and immutable provider global-label exclusion at application lifetime; no hot configuration.

control.contract: Explicit initialization and manual singleton attach/detach, no automatic owner cleanup, drain or restart recovery.
